class.name: JRPGEnemyData
class.description: Database entry for a foe: its battle image, fixed parameters, rewards, drops, action patterns and traits.

method.name: make_action
method.description: Returns an action pattern dictionary for [member actions]. [param param1] and [param param2] depend on the condition: turns A and B for [constant CONDITION_TURN], a lower and upper bound in basis points for [constant CONDITION_HP] and [constant CONDITION_MP], a state, level or switch ID otherwise. [param rating] is kept between 1 and 9.

method.name: make_drop
method.description: Returns a drop dictionary for [member drops]: a 1 in [param denominator] chance (1 to 1000) to drop the item, weapon or armor [param data_id].

members.member: Action patterns, as dictionaries with [code]skill_id[/code], [code]condition_type[/code], [code]param1[/code], [code]param2[/code] and [code]rating[/code]. See [method make_action].
Path of the enemy's battle image.
Up to [constant MAX_DROPS] possible drops, as dictionaries with [code]kind[/code], [code]data_id[/code] and [code]denominator[/code]. See [method make_drop]. Extra drops are cut with a warning.
EXP the party earns for defeating the enemy.
Money the party earns for defeating the enemy.
Color shift applied to the battle image, in degrees.
The eight parameters at battle start: max HP 1 to 999999, max MP 0 to 9999, the others 0 to 999.
Traits of the enemy, as dictionaries with [code]code[/code], [code]data_id[/code] and [code]value[/code].

constants.constant: Allowed on turns A + B * X.
Allowed while the enemy's HP is within a band.
Allowed while the enemy's MP is within a band.
Allowed while the enemy has a state.
Allowed when the highest party level reaches a value.
Allowed while a switch is on.
